summary: The declared dependency-edge ROLE column (cinatra#2090 S3, epic #2086). ONE additive nullable column on extension_dependency_edge: declared_role text, constrained to the declared vocabulary ('matcher' | 'authoring') by a CHECK that also admits NULL. The S3 separation rule turns a co-located skill bundle into a declared cinatra.dependencies edge, and an artifact extension declares MORE THAN ONE skill edge (the classifier's rules and the chat's authoring methodology), so the edge has to record which host surface it feeds — the artifact matcher's trust anchor and the chat's authoring skill id both re-key onto the RESOLVED target of the edge carrying their role. The canonical ExtensionDependency.role already carries the value from the manifest reader; without this column a write/read round-trip through extension_dependency_edge would silently turn a roled edge back into a role-less one (caught in review, pinned by packages/extensions/src/__tests__/dependency-edge-role-roundtrip.test.ts). No backfill, no rewrite, no constraint change on existing data: every existing row reads NULL, which is exactly its unchanged meaning ('no role' — also what a plain agent→skill injectable edge declares). Idempotent ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS twin of the fresh-install bootstrap DDL in dependencyEdgeSchemaQueries (src/lib/extension-grant-schema.ts), shipped in the SAME PR (core__0054 / core__0079 / core__0085 precedent) and pinned by a DDL-parity test. down() drops the CHECK and the column, reverting every persisted edge to 'no role'; the manifests are untouched, so a re-install re-derives the roles. SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: assigned at merge — shipped max on origin/main at build time is core__0085; a concurrent lane may claim 0086 first, in which case renumber-at-merge is normal. migrations/** is HIGH-RISK: owner approval required; the lane never merges.
